newsitem.title: USA: Democrats hold Senate seat in Georgia - TV networks.
newsitem.headline: Democrats hold Senate seat in Georgia - TV networks.

text.p: Democrat Max Cleland, a triple amputee and former head of the Veterans Administration, defeated Republican businessman Guy Millner for Georgia's Senate seat, major television networks projected on Tuesday.

Cleland will replace Democratic Sen. Sam Nunn, who retired this year. Holding on to this Southern seat was crucial for Democrats who hope to gain control of the Senate. Republicans held a 53-47 majority.
